title.zh: 法務合規與重大爭議解決戰略 (法務長 / General Counsel 視角)
title.en: Legal Affairs & Dispute Resolution Strategy (General Counsel Level)

slide_title.zh: 爭議現狀與法律曝險評估 (SCQA & The Ask)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：公司在 [某跨國市場/新事業部] 取得重大商業進展，但同時面臨 [競爭對手訴訟/監管調查/合約違約]
衝突 (Complication)：若進入曠日廢時的傳統訴訟程序，不僅將耗費巨額外部律師費，更可能觸發最高 [X 金額] 的損害賠償與商譽受損
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：法務部提議啟動「替代性爭議解決 (ADR)」與合規防禦戰略，懇請董事會授權 [X 金額] 的談判和解底線
en: Situation: While achieving significant commercial milestones in [Market/Division], we are now facing [Competitor Litigation/Regulatory Probe/Breach of Contract].
Complication: Engaging in protracted traditional litigation will drain CapEx on external counsel and expose us to maximum damages of [X Amount].
The Ask: Legal proposes an Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) & Compliance Defense strategy. Requesting Board authorization for a settlement threshold of [X Amount].

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，法務部的職責不是為了打官司而打官司，而是為了『保護企業的商業利益最大化』。我們目前面臨的法律爭議，如果走傳統訴訟，將是一場消耗戰。今天的提案，是透過精算法律風險與談判籌碼，為公司找出一條成本最低、傷害最小的戰略路徑。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, the Legal Department's mandate is not to litigate for the sake of litigation, but to maximize and protect enterprise commercial value. The current dispute, if taken to a traditional trial, will be a war of attrition. Today's briefing calculates our legal exposure and leverage, proposing the most cost-effective and least damaging strategic path.

slide_title.zh: 談判籌碼與替代性爭議解決 (Leverage & ADR Strategy)

zh: 籌碼分析 (Leverage Matrix)：我方在 [專利有效性/合約免責條款] 上佔據絕對優勢，且掌握對方的 [某項弱點] 作為反訴籌碼
替代性爭議解決 (ADR)：強烈建議繞開公開法庭，優先採取「商業調解 (Mediation)」或「保密仲裁 (Arbitration)」
和解 ROI (ROI of Settlement)：「和解」不是退讓，而是停損。在 [X 金額] 內達成和解，將比訴訟省下 [X] 的時間與律師成本
en: Leverage Matrix: We hold overwhelming superiority regarding [Patent Validity/Exculpatory Clauses] and possess leverage for counterclaims against their [Specific Weakness].
Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR): Strongly advise bypassing public courts in favor of 'Commercial Mediation' or 'Confidential Arbitration'.
ROI of Settlement: Settlement is not surrender; it is strategic loss-cutting. Settling within [X Amount] yields a higher ROI than absorbing years of litigation costs.

speaker_notes.zh: 在法庭上沒有絕對的贏家，只有成本的消耗。經過盤點，我們握有極強的反訴籌碼。因此，我們建議啟動『商業調解 (Mediation)』。請各位理解，在商業世界裡，『和解不是認輸，而是精算後的 ROI 決策』，這能將主導權從法官手裡拿回我們自己手上，並確保商業機密不被公開。
speaker_notes.en: There are no absolute winners in court, only capital depletion. After auditing our position, we hold strong counterclaim leverage. Therefore, we recommend initiating 'Commercial Mediation.' Please understand that in business, 'settling is not surrendering; it is a calculated ROI decision.' This retains control in our hands—not a judge's—and keeps our trade secrets strictly confidential.

slide_title.zh: 全球合規防禦與長臂管轄 (Global Compliance & Extraterritoriality)

zh: 監管雷達 (Regulatory Radar)：針對 [歐盟 AI 法案 / GDPR / 美國出口管制] 等具備「長臂管轄權」的法規，已完成曝險盤點
合規護欄 (Compliance Guardrails)：將合規機制從「法務後端審查 (Reactive)」前推至「產品研發初期 (Privacy/Security by Design)」
反壟斷與競爭法 (Antitrust)：針對即將展開的 [跨國併購/定價策略]，已取得外部權威律所的無違法疑慮 (Clean) 法律意見書
en: Regulatory Radar: Completed exposure audits against extraterritorial regulations such as [EU AI Act / GDPR / US Export Controls].
Compliance Guardrails: Shifting compliance from 'reactive legal review' to 'proactive integration' during early-stage R&D (Privacy by Design).
Antitrust Readiness: Secured 'clean' legal opinions from Tier-1 external counsel regarding our upcoming [M&A / Pricing Strategy].

speaker_notes.zh: 除了單一的爭議，我們更要防範全球監管的『長臂管轄』。不管是歐盟的 AI 法案還是數據隱私法規，我們的戰略是將『合規』前置化 (By Design)。法務部不再只是產品上市前蓋章的單位，而是從研發第一天就介入的『護航者』，確保我們在全球市場暢行無阻。
speaker_notes.en: Beyond isolated disputes, we must defend against the 'extraterritorial reach' of global regulators. Whether it's the EU AI Act or data privacy laws, our strategy is 'Compliance by Design.' The Legal department is no longer a reactive checkpoint before launch, but a proactive 'navigator' involved from day one of R&D to ensure unhindered global market access.

slide_title.zh: 智慧財產權與商業護城河 (IP Strategy & Business Moats)

zh: 專利佈局 (Patent Portfolio)：從「防禦型申請」轉為「攻擊型佈局」，針對競爭對手的技術路徑進行專利卡位 (Blockading)
營業秘密保護 (Trade Secrets)：升級核心演算法與客戶名單的保護層級，啟動零信任資安與員工競業禁止 (NDA/NCA) 稽核
IP 變現 (IP Monetization)：盤點非核心專利資產，透過授權 (Licensing) 或交互授權 (Cross-licensing) 創造新的營收來源
en: Patent Portfolio: Pivoting from 'defensive filings' to 'offensive blockading', strategically patenting along competitors' anticipated tech trajectories.
Trade Secrets: Escalating the protection of core algorithms and client lists via Zero-Trust IT audits and strict NDA/NCA enforcement.
IP Monetization: Auditing non-core IP assets to generate net-new revenue streams through strategic licensing or cross-licensing.

speaker_notes.zh: 智財權 (IP) 不只是掛在牆上的證書，它是我們的『商業護城河』與『武器』。我們正在將專利戰略從被動防禦轉為主動攻擊，封鎖競爭對手的研發路徑。同時，針對最核心的營業秘密，法務部已聯合 HR 與 IT，確保離職員工無法帶走任何一行關鍵程式碼或客戶名單。
speaker_notes.en: Intellectual Property (IP) isn't just certificates on a wall; it is our 'business moat' and 'weapon.' We are pivoting our patent strategy from passive defense to active offense, blockading competitors' R&D paths. Simultaneously, Legal has partnered with HR and IT to ensure departing employees absolutely cannot extract a single line of code or client data.

slide_title.zh: 下一步行動與預算訴求 (Next Steps & Legal Ask)
slide_title.en: Next Steps & External Counsel Budget Ask

zh: 90 天行動計畫 (90-Day Plan)：於 30 天內完成對造的底牌刺探，90 天內召開首次正式的商業調解會議
外部顧問預算 (External Counsel Ask)：懇請核准 [X 金額] 聘請 [某頂級律所] 作為本次訴訟/調解的主辦律師 (Lead Counsel)
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：請求董事會正式授權法務長，在 [X 金額] 與 [某項商業條件] 的底線內，全權進行和解談判
en: 90-Day Plan: Execute discovery/leverage probing within 30 days, and convene the first formal Commercial Mediation session within 90 days.
External Counsel Ask: Requesting [X Budget] to retain [Tier-1 Law Firm] as Lead Counsel for this dispute/mediation.
Call to Action: Requesting formal Board authorization for the General Counsel to execute settlement negotiations up to a hard limit of [X Amount] and [Specific Terms].

speaker_notes.zh: 最後是我們的執行藍圖。為了打贏這場仗，我們需要最頂尖的外部法律團隊火力支援，懇請核准相關預算。最重要的是，談判桌上瞬息萬變，我們請求董事會今天給予明確的『和解金額底線』與授權，讓法務團隊能以最敏捷的速度，為公司爭取最有利的結果。
speaker_notes.en: Finally, our execution roadmap. To win this battle, we require the heavy firepower of elite external counsel; we respectfully request approval for this retainer budget. Most importantly, negotiations are highly fluid. We ask the Board today for a definitive 'settlement threshold' mandate, empowering the Legal team to maneuver agilely and secure the best commercial outcome.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『法務合規與重大爭議解決』簡報。受眾為董事會或 CEO。內容必須展現法務長 (General Counsel) 結合法理與商業 ROI 的頂尖思維：1. 運用 SCQA 架構說明目前的法律曝險與不作為成本，2. 強調運用『替代性爭議解決 (ADR)』與『商業調解 (Mediation)』來取代昂貴的訴訟，展現『和解是商業決策』的高度，3. 帶入全球合規 (如歐盟法規長臂管轄) 與『合規前置化 (By Design)』的防禦戰略，4. 探討智慧財產權 (IP) 的攻擊性佈局與營業秘密保護，5. 結尾給出 90 天談判藍圖，並爭取明確的和解授權與外部律師預算。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需極具法理權威性、談判威懾力，並隨時扣緊『保護企業商業價值』的核心。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Legal Affairs & Dispute Resolution' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors or CEO. Demonstrate the elite strategic mindset of a General Counsel bridging legal doctrine with commercial ROI: 1. Use SCQA to frame the legal exposure and Cost of Inaction. 2. Emphasize Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) and Commercial Mediation over costly litigation, framing settlement as a calculated business decision. 3. Incorporate Global Compliance (extraterritorial reach like EU laws) and a 'Compliance by Design' defensive strategy. 4. Discuss offensive IP blockading and strict Trade Secret protection. 5. Conclude with a 90-day negotiation roadmap, asking for a definitive settlement mandate and external counsel budget. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project legal authority, negotiation deterrence, and a relentless focus on protecting enterprise commercial value.
